rotation.command: settings put system accelerometer_rotation 0 && settings put system user_rotation {value}

brightness.command: settings put system screen_brightness_mode 0 && settings put system screen_brightness {value}

packages.command: u=$(am get-current-user) || exit; echo __ALL__; pm list packages --user "$u"; echo __SYSTEM__; pm list packages -s --user "$u"; echo __DISABLED__; pm list packages -d --user "$u"; echo __END__

app-launch.command: u=$(am get-current-user) || exit; c=$(cmd package resolve-activity --brief --user "$u" -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER {value} | tail -n 1); case "$c" in */*) am start --user "$u" -n "$c";; *) echo '应用没有可启动的 Activity' >&2; exit 1;; esac
